headline: Raymond James Maintains Outperform on Martin Marietta Materials, Lowers Price Target to $640
summary: Raymond James  analyst Patrick Tyler Brown   maintains Martin Marietta Materials (NYSE:MLM) with a Outperform and lowers the price target from $660 to $640.
